mentions.name: Simple Machines Made Simple
mentions.description: An educational book about simple machines that includes little hands-on mini demos built into the book. About 11,000 copies were shipped to the author's house, and roughly 80% of them need some type of rework before they can be shipped out to buyers.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a book, Simple Machines Made Simple, and I got about 11k copies shipped to my house about two weeks ago. I'm now trying to fix all the books and get them shipped out. They are books with little mini demos in them, and about 80% of the books need some type of rework.
